dict.string: AnimeArmory needs access to novels, images, audio, and video files you place on Desktop so it can import them into your projects.
AnimeArmory needs access to novels and project references in Documents when you paste paths or ask the AI agent to process them.
AnimeArmory needs access to downloaded novels and media assets when you paste paths or drag them into a project.
AnimeArmory needs access to selected novels and media assets on network volumes when they are used as project inputs.
AnimeArmory needs access to selected novels and media assets on external drives when they are used as project inputs.
